findings.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
findings.finding: 138,797 EDGAR 8-K press releases 2005-2023; FinBERT best of text-embedding methods tested; structurally-aggregated multi-section 'SoftMean' sentiment score beats whole-document scalar score, same-day return spread +4.58%/-5.06%; soft info content comparable to numeric EPS surprise.
findings.staging_rationale: Direct, low-effort refinement candidate for confirmed production strategy H174 (same FinBERT-on-8-K pipeline family, same event type). Not adopted/implemented — staged as a wiki research-lead note for a future backtesting session to evaluate section-level sentiment aggregation against the current single-scalar-score baseline.

findings.title: (unnamed companion paper on 8-K text feature engineering surveyed but not independently novel)
findings.finding: Sub-agent flagged a second, more incremental paper on 8-K linguistic feature engineering (readability/tone metrics) that substantially overlaps with H163/H168/H172/H175's already-exhausted FinBERT/readability feature space with no new mechanism.
findings.staging_rationale: Redundant with already-exhausted H163/H168/H172/H175 findings (transcript coverage bias root cause, FinBERT CLS embedding tested and NOT CONFIRMED, readability features not previously beating whole-document FinBERT score). No new angle to stage.

angles.status: 1 finding (flagged, not endorsed) + confirmed open gap

findings.title: Drift-regime conditioning factor on cross-sectional momentum
findings.finding: Claims a backtested Sharpe ratio of approximately 13 for a drift-regime-conditioned momentum strategy — far outside the range of any credible or previously-audited result in this pipeline (best-ever production blend Sharpe is 4.158; every single-strategy OOS Sharpe above ~3 in this pipeline's history has subsequently been found look-ahead-bias-driven per the H343/H344/H345/H346/H355/H356/H411/H416/H417/H418/H470/H483/H484/H492/H493/H509/H510-H514 retraction family).
findings.relevance_score: HIGH (but treated as a bug-hunt candidate, not an endorsement)
findings.staging_rationale: Genuinely new-to-wiki information relevant to the still-open H157/H158 gap (broad-universe/sector-neutral cross-sectional momentum, referenced since H156 PARTIAL but never formally run), but staged explicitly as a skeptical bug-hunt flag rather than a build recommendation, given the extreme Sharpe claim and this pipeline's own extensive track record of such claims collapsing on as-of-date audit.

angles.gap_check: Confirmed via grep across hypothesis-log.md, factor-models.md, momentum-strategies.md: H157 and H158 do not exist as run hypotheses despite being referenced as the logical next step after H156 (PARTIAL, 54-stock survivorship-biased NASDAQ universe, best n=20 OOS Sharpe 0.866-1.295, doesn't beat QQQ). This remains a genuinely open gap; no paper found tonight filled it outright, but finding #1 above (2511.12490) is a candidate input for a future H157/H158 run, conditional on bug-auditing its methodology first.

angles.note: No new papers beyond FINSABER (arXiv:2505.07078), which was already ingested as its own wiki source page earlier today (2026-08-26) by the separate wiki-rotation task (wiki/trading/sources/finsaber-llm-investing-benchmark-2026.md) — confirmed via direct read, correctly not re-flagged. Alpha Illusion arXiv:2605.16895, LLM-embeddings-vs-price EMH test arXiv:2509.01590, and FINSABER at-scale benchmark) all pointing to the same conclusion: LLM trading-agent alpha claims do not survive scale, longer horizons, or honest cost/bias accounting. H280/H281/H319 remain correctly deprioritized. No action needed.

angles.status: 2 findings, both verified real and staged as one combined tools note

findings.title: ArturSepp/OptimalPortfolios
findings.finding: 92 stars, MIT license, created 2023-07-08, last pushed 2026-08-24. Python library for portfolio optimization: max-Sharpe, min-variance, risk-parity, robust/shrinkage-covariance variants. Verified real via direct GitHub API call (not just search snippet).

findings.title: ArturSepp/factorlasso
findings.finding: 24 stars, GPL-3.0 license, created 2026-03-22, last pushed 2026-08-23. LASSO-based factor selection to distinguish genuine return drivers from redundant/collinear noise. Verified real via direct GitHub API call.
findings.staging_rationale: Combined with OptimalPortfolios into a single wiki tools page (same author/ecosystem, complementary use cases — portfolio construction vs. factor diagnostics). Both relevant to formalizing the hand-tuned production blend weighting and the ad hoc cross-strategy correlation checks scattered across H241/H313/H354/H361/H362/H470. Reference/tools note only, no adoption action, no install performed.
